The text of every vat (Gujarati, English translation, transliteration and footnotes) is from the 7-prakaran edition of Swami Ni Vaato.

The feeling lists and the Seva, Life as a householder and Hard words lists are a personal selection made after reading all 1,484 vatos. 382 vatos have no topic and can be found through search or by prakaran.

After your first visit this site works offline, and it can be added to your home screen like an app. Saved vatos, text size and theme stay on this device only; nothing is sent anywhere.
